N-L-main.objects: A smooth Riemannian m-manifold and the first positive scalar eigenvalue.
N-L-main.fixed_and_variable: M and g are arbitrary fixed data satisfying the pointwise curvature inequality.
N-L-main.hypotheses: For every point and tangent vector, Ric(v,v)>=(m-1)g(v,v).
N-L-main.equations: The normalized tensor inequality and Delta=-div grad are explicit.
N-L-main.quantifiers: Every such manifold has lambda_1>=m, with no stronger equality conclusion.
N-L-main.conclusion: The first positive eigenvalue is at least the dimension.
N-L-main.local_definitions: Closed, connected, first positive eigenvalue and the Laplacian sign are local and unambiguous.
